title: Proceedings - 34. Workshop Computational Intelligence: Berlin, 21.-22. November 2024
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: This conference proceedings volume contains the contributions from the 34th ""Computational Intelligence"" workshop, held in Berlin from November 21 to November 22, 2024. The main focus areas are methods, applications, and tools for: Fuzzy Systems, Artificial Neural Networks, Evolutionary Algorithms, and Data Mining Techniques, as well as comparative studies of methods based on industrial and benchmark problems.
